offering_description.value: Produces fuel-grade ethanol at a single plant in Lamberton, Minnesota, and sells it to fuel marketers and blenders. It also sells distillers grains and corn oil made during production, mainly to animal feed buyers. The company is owned by its farmer members and runs on corn bought from local grain suppliers.

primary_products.value: fuel ethanol; distillers grains; corn oil

customer_segment.value: B2B: fuel marketers, gasoline blenders, animal feed buyers, dairy and beef feedlots

revenue_model.value: product sales: ethanol, distillers grains and corn oil sold to fuel and feed buyers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: converts purchased corn into ethanol and co-products, sold to fuel marketers and feed buyers

geography_served.value: US national: Minnesota plant, ethanol and co-products shipped by rail and truck to buyers across the US

specialization.value: niche specialist: single ethanol production line with its co-products

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: ethanol marketing agreements with third-party fuel marketers; direct sales: distillers grains and corn oil sold directly to feed buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: air and water permits from state environmental agency, federal renewable fuel standard compliance

notes: Plant capacity, sales arrangements and co-product mix may have changed since my information was last updated.
